features.name: behavior_activity_js
features.description: Jensen-Shannon similarity between 24-hour UTC activity probability distributions

features.name: behavior_inter_event_log_ratio
features.description: Log-ratio similarity between mean inter-event activity intervals (sigma_ref = 2.0)

features.name: behavior_cadence_weekly_ratio
features.description: Ratio of weekly posting/listing cadences per active calendar week

features.name: behavior_category_cosine
features.description: Cosine similarity across normalized product category vectors

features.name: graph_jaccard
features.formula: J(Gamma_A, Gamma_B) = |Gamma_A cap Gamma_B| / |Gamma_A cup Gamma_B|
features.description: Jaccard coefficient of shared counterparties in the communication network

features.name: graph_adamic_adar_norm
features.formula: tanh(AA / 2.0) where AA = sum_{z in Gamma_A cap Gamma_B, deg(z)>1} 1/ln(deg(z))
features.description: Exact Adamic-Adar common neighbor index normalized via hyperbolic tangent; unobserved degrees are strictly skipped
